title: Optimizing LLM Inference: Fluid-Guided Online Scheduling with Memory Constraints
authors: Ruicheng Ao; Gan Luo; David Simchi-Levi; Xinshang Wang
affiliations: MIT Institute for Data, Systems, and Society, Peking University School of Mathematical Sciences, Alibaba Group
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Length prediction, Capacity planning, Performance modeling

problem_statement.en: LLM inference suffers endogenous KV-cache memory growth during decode: overflow forces costly prompt evictions and recomputation, and a workload theoretically inside the fluid stability region can still destabilize under naive FCFS due to cascading evictions.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理在 decode 階段 KV cache 內生成長，記憶體溢位將觸發代價昂貴的提示驅逐與重新計算；即使工作負載理論上落在 fluid stability region 內，FCFS 仍可能因驅逐連鎖反應而失穩。

key_innovation.en: A fluid-limit approximation that characterizes the equilibrium batch composition and KV-cache memory requirement M*, plus two threshold-based admission policies, WAIT (Waiting for Accumulated Inference Threshold) for known output lengths and Nested WAIT for unknown output lengths via nested decode-segment thresholds. Both policies asymptotically approximate the fluid benchmark under the stated memory conditions.
key_innovation.zh: 提出 fluid-limit 近似，刻畫均衡批次組成與 KV cache 記憶體需求 M*，並設計兩種閾值型 admission policy：WAIT（已知輸出長度）與 Nested WAIT（未知輸出長度，透過 decode 段嵌套閾值）。兩者在所述記憶體條件下，皆漸近逼近 fluid benchmark。

key_improvements.en: In Vidur simulations of Llama-2-7B on a single A100 80GB, WAIT and Nested WAIT enlarge the empirically observed stable operating range relative to vLLM and Sarathi-Serve and reduce mean end-to-end latency most clearly near capacity and under overload; appendix reports real-GPU validation.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Vidur 模擬 Llama-2-7B 於單一 A100 80GB 設定下，WAIT 與 Nested WAIT 相對 vLLM 與 Sarathi-Serve 擴大實測穩定運作區間，並在接近容量與過載時最明顯地降低端到端平均延遲；附錄補充真實 GPU 驗證。

reported_accuracy: Linear iteration-time fit reported on A100 80GB; quantitative R^2 not specified in main text
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Poisson arrivals), Vidur simulator workloads, Real-GPU end-to-end traces

scope_assumptions.en: Models iteration time as affine in resident KV-cache size (tau(B) = d0 + d1 * sum of cached tokens) under Llama-2-7B on A100. Assumes single-GPU scheduling unit; multi-GPU deployments apply same admission logic per partition. Evicted prompts restart from prefill (LIFO). Nested WAIT uses an additional moderate-scale safety buffer to hedge against eviction under unknown output lengths.
scope_assumptions.zh: 在 Llama-2-7B 於 A100 上將 iteration 時間建模為 KV cache 駐留量的仿射函式 tau(B) = d0 + d1 * 累計 cached tokens；以單 GPU 為 scheduling 單位，多 GPU 部署在每個分區套用相同 admission 邏輯。被驅逐的提示自 prefill 重啟（LIFO）。Nested WAIT 在輸出長度未知時，額外採用中等規模 safety buffer 以對抗驅逐風險。
